verdict.rationale: Aircall is a SaaS platform with a public developer portal, so publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The pack only shows conventional human-oriented tutorials and API references, with no mention of llms.txt, markdown-for-LLM docs, or agent-targeted documentation. Its 'AI Agents' and 'AI Assistants' are call-handling product features, not documentation meant for coding agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
